tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_feasible_deck_effect = {
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_feasible_unique_deck
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_rebuild_feasible_deck_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 1 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 2 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 3 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 4 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 5 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 5 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 6 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 6 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 7 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 8 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 8 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 9 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 9 value = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_rule_dispatch_id value = 10 }
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_site_rule_can_build_candidate_trigger = yes }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = 10 value = 1 }
	}

tv_wonder_generic_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_proposal
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_proposal_owner
	random_key_in_variable_map = {
		variable = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck
		scope:tv_wonder_proposal_owner = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal value = prev }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_proposal
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_proposal_owner
	random_key_in_variable_map = {
		variable = tv_wonder_feasible_unique_deck
		scope:tv_wonder_proposal_owner = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_proposal value = prev }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_roll_next_slot_from_priority_deck_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_unique_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_unique_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_generic_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_generic_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_remove_current_proposal_from_deck_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_proposal ?= { this >= 1 } }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_current_proposal_id value = var:tv_wonder_proposal }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_generic_deck key = local_var:tv_wonder_current_proposal_id }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_feasible_unique_deck key = local_var:tv_wonder_current_proposal_id }
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_current_proposal_id
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_accept_proposal_tooltip_effect = {
	custom_tooltip = { text = tv_wonder_accept_proposal_desc }
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_revealed
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_1
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_2
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_3
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_4
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_5
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_current_suitability_actual_cache_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_1
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_2
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_3
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_4
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_5
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_revealed value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_revealed value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_revealed|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key)" }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_1 value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key)" }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key add = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_2 value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key)" }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key add = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_3 value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key)" }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key add = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_4 value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key)" }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key add = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_current_actual_5 value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_key)" }
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_row_key
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_suitability_actuals_effect = {
	clear_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual

		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp multiply = 0.25 }
		remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 511 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = 511 value = var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_row_temp
	}
	tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key
			has_variable = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_surveyed
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			}
		}
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key)" }
				prev = { set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_tier value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp } }
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_calculate_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 1 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {
					remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
				}
				remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 2 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
				prev = {

					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }

			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 3 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual
					is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual target = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual|prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }

					add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual key = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }

		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 4 }
		scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = {

					has_variable_map = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual

tv_wonder_mechanics_store_survey_on_location_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_calculate_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_surveyed key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = 1 }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_scale_competence }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_logistics_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_logistics_competence }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_organization_competence key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_organization_competence }
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_scale_tier key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_scale_tier }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = var:tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key multiply = 10 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_row_key add = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_actual
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_actual target = var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_actual|var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key)" }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= {
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_survey_suitability_actual key = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_row_key value = prev.var:tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_location_cache_temp
		}
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_row_key
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_mechanic_key
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_wonder_key
	}
}

		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 7.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { modifier:fort_level > 0 } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { OR = { location_rank ?= location_rank:city location_rank ?= location_rank:megalopolis } } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_calculate_unique_carcassonne_castle_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 200
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { is_capital = yes } }
			tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 5 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.modifier:harbor_suitability }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_calculate_unique_brest_naval_port_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 201
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 0.25 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_calculate_unique_colmar_old_town_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_selected_survey_already_cached_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_start_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target
		}
		tv_wonder_clear_current_survey_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_suitability_actuals_effect = yes
		scope:target = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_site value = scope:target }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_stage value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_active value = 1 }
			tv_wonder_prepare_survey_competence_targets_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_complete_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_survey_active_trigger = yes }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_store_survey_on_location_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_reveal_suitability_knowledge_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_speed
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_monthly_gain
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_event_location }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average value = var:tv_wonder_scale_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_logistics_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_organization_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average divide = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.300 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_tooltip_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_id } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_id value = $wonder_id$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_level value = $wonder_level$ }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_ritual_style value = $wonder_ritual_style$ }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count }
			change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_location_display_state_effect = {
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_tooltip_overflow_count value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_1_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_2_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_display_slot_3_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_1_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_2_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_3_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_4_ritual_style
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_id
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_level
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_tooltip_slot_5_ritual_style
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_location_display_state_effect = yes
	save_scope_as = tv_wonder_location_display_location
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_location
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type
		}
		every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_location
			limit = {
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type target = this }
				OR = {
					"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_unique_id_to_location|this)" = { this = scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location }
					"global_variable_map(tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type|this)" = {
						scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
							has_building = prev
						}
					}
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id value = prev }
				set_local_variable = {
					name = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type
					value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_unique_id_to_final_building_type|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id)"
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_id value = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 6 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 6 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 5 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 5 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 4 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 3 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 2 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 2 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_building = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type }
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style value = 1 }
				}
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_tooltip_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style }
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_wonder_id
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_display_id
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style
		}
		every_key_in_global_variable_map = {
			variable = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_display_id
			limit = {
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style target = this }
				scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
					has_building = prev
				}
			}
			scope:tv_wonder_location_display_location = {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value = prev }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_id value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_display_id|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type)" }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_final_building_type_to_ritual_style|local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type)" }
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 6 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 6 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 5 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 5 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 4 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 3 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 2 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 2 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						location_building_level = { building_type = local_var:tv_wonder_location_display_building_type value >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_location_display_level value = 1 }
				}
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_display_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_push_location_tooltip_slot_effect = { wonder_id = var:tv_wonder_location_display_id wonder_level = var:tv_wonder_location_display_level wonder_ritual_style = var:tv_wonder_location_display_ritual_style }
				remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_location_display_building_type
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_world_location_display_state_effect = {
	every_location_in_the_world = {
		tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_location_display_state_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_reveal_suitability_knowledge_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id
			has_global_variable_map = tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = var:tv_wonder_locked_mechanic_id }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_row_count value = "global_variable_map(tv_wonder_mechanic_id_to_suitability_row_count|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key)" }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed }
						AND = {
							has_variable_map = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed
							NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed target = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key } }
						}
					}
				}
				remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = 0 }
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value value = "variable_map(tv_wonder_suitability_revealed|local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key)" }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value < local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_count }
				change_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value add = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value > local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_count }
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value value = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_row_count }
			}
			remove_from_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_wonder_suitability_revealed key = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key value = local_var:tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_refresh_current_suitability_display_cache_effect = yes
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_reveal_value
			remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_row_count
		}
		remove_local_variable = tv_wonder_suitability_mechanic_key
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_recalculate_total_owned_buildings_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings add = this.num_buildings }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_snapshot_total_owned_buildings_effect = {
	tv_wonder_mechanics_recalculate_total_owned_buildings_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ritual_total_buildings_baseline value = var:tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings }
}

	remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_total_buildings_baseline
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_current_total_buildings

	if = {
		limit = {

		tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_maybe_complete_active_ritual_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
			tv_wonder_selected_ritual_completion_requirements_met_trigger = yes
		}
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_completion_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_timer
		tv_wonder_mechanics_clear_selected_ritual_runtime_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress }
		tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_selected_ritual_progress_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_mechanics_maybe_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_confirm_ceremony_effect = {
	tv_wonder_index_refresh_country_cache_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_timed_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_timed_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_auxiliary_building_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_auxiliary_building_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_generic_artwork_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes }
			random_work_of_art_in_country = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_sacrificed_artwork }
			destroy_art = scope:tv_wonder_sacrificed_artwork
			if = {
				limit = { tv_wonder_selected_deferred_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes }
				tv_wonder_mechanics_start_deferred_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
				tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_deferred_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_mechanics_start_deferred_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_immediate_ritual_trigger = yes
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_scaled_gold_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
					tv_wonder_selected_generic_prestige_decoration_ritual_trigger = yes
				}
			}
			tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_immediate_ritual_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_finalize_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
